attempted_claim: Let (M,omega_pent) be the genus-2 Veech surface unfolding the regular-pentagon billiard (double pentagon), and let phi_theta^t be the unit-speed directional translation flow in direction theta in S^1 preserving area omega_pent. Does there exist an exponent beta>0, depending only on the Teichmuller curve SL(2,R).(M,omega_pent), such that for Lebesgue-a.e. theta in S^1 there is C(theta)<infinity with, for all zero-mean Lipschitz f on M and all g in L^2(M,omega_pent) and all T>=2, (1/T)∫_0^T |<f∘phi_theta^t,g>_{L^2}|^2 dt ≤ C(theta) ||f||_Lip^2 ||g||_{L^2}^2 T^{-beta}?
decisive_failure: No complete result is claimed. The conditional spectral reduction (curve-uniform Holder bound implies the target Cesaro bound) was verified locally but depends on a rank-1 uniform twisted estimate that was not proved. Literature coverage rests on fulltext inspection of Forni 1908.11040 and Avila-Forni-Safaee 2105.10547 plus one consolidated search; acquisition of one tangential DOI failed but was not load-bearing. The CLEAN_EXIT judgment reflects the bounded pass, not a proof that the target is false.
